long_description: Experimental research prototype for deterministic proposal Expressions, caller-supplied semantic invariants, supplied-lineage checks, and portable content-addressed packets. Product utility over ordinary review is unproven. Every result remains proposal-scoped and not persisted by the service; validation never claims source truth, authority, behavioral success, acceptance, operative status, repository head, or complete lineage.
capabilities: Validate structure, semantic invariants, evidence boundaries, and supplied lineage
Compile and verify portable release packets
Render traceable human-review, human-action, and machine views
starter_prompts: Model this policy requirement as a proposal-scoped normative Expression.
Audit this Expression's integrity, readiness, lineage, and evidence boundaries.
Render a traceable human-action view from this operational Expression.
release_notes: Dormant draft only; not submitted for OpenAI review. Document Systems 0.3.0 is an experimental, value-unproven research prototype. The public MCP remains stateless, read-only, and unauthenticated.
